tests.expectedCurrentState: red. The delivered run stops at the first failed positive (tests/failed-execution-feedback-test.mjs:245): the trusted verifier only admits benchmark.status=complete / queue task.status=completed, and roundCorrectnessFacts only walks benchmark rows, so nothing records or archives a failed candidate observation yet. The file must not be weakened to match this pre-integration tree.
covers: Result-envelope fidelity: correctness.error and each case.error keep the real string error.message, while result.error, correctness.failure and the final case failure carry the same typed error object; the committed fixture-level assertion reports the real computed maxDiff/rmse/cosDiff for a mismatch and null (never a fabricated 0) for the OPERATOR_CANDIDATE_EXCEPTION case whose metrics were never computed

Complete executionPackage binding: makeBinding/buildFailedFixture/buildFailedSnapshot build the same workspaceId/target/build/adapter for payload, projected result, persisted benchmark state and queue receipt; the admission port validates the actual request (Mission, workspace, package/environment/acceptance digests, run identity, candidate binding, target/build/adapter) instead of approving unconditionally

Trusted failed-observation positive: bound candidate correctness failure (OPERATOR_CORRECTNESS_MISMATCH) and candidate exception (OPERATOR_CANDIDATE_EXCEPTION) verify; proof.summary deterministically carries typed code, phase/role, failed case name/category, total/executed/passed counts and the real error

Bounded failure detail: a 5000-repeat failure message is accepted but the longest surviving run of the repeated character must be <=2000 and the TAIL_MARKER tail must be gone, so a >2000-char suffix cannot pass behind a loose total-length bound

Failed verifier negative matrix, each negative mutating exactly one target on a fixture that verifies unmutated. Semantic negatives (counts/prefix/case name/zero total/probe/simulation) mutate every corresponding result/queue/environment copy and assert queue-vs-projection equality before the acceptance call, so they cannot be rejected early as a queue != projection disagreement; the dedicated one-sided negatives (queue error/correctness/evidence/executionPackage mismatch) stay one-sided. Cases: pass/failed outcome contradiction, benchmark complete, wrong Mission/candidate/applied candidate/run/request/workspace, wrong queue taskId, running/cancelled queue, missing or unconfirmed benchmark/queue release, wrong package/environment/acceptance/admission/prepared-artifact binding, invalid prepared-artifact port verdict alone (digest untouched), queue result evidence/correctness/error/executionPackage disagreement, missing projected experienceEvidence, missing readTask port, role=oracle, phase=preflight/benchmark, OPERATOR_ORACLE_EXCEPTION, unfrozen backend code, not_run, fabricated counts/prefix/failedCase/case-name/zero total, missing or incomplete real target probe, simulation executionMode and conflicting liveHardware=false

Rejection is read-only for the trusted verifier: a rejected observation must not rewrite the projected result, the observation evidence or the queue receipt. Real Experience repository non-growth is asserted separately in scenario E
Successful legacy observation path still verifies and still rejects a wrong candidate identity

Real production failed-round pipeline: createBenchmarkProjectionService -> applyOperatorTestSnapshot -> roundExperience.collect -> real filesystem Experience repository -> resetMissionRunState archive -> agent-round-service + agentRuntime next prompt/audit with an injected provider port double; no Claude/Codex process, GPU, network or N=20 batch

First failed candidate correctness produces result.benchmark=[] and is recorded once through the real verifier/repository with source=execution, publishable=false, exact evidence identity and summary content; replaying the identical observation is idempotent (same id/version/evidenceKey, no new record)

Archived round facts take the top-level result.correctness as authority: status/total/failedCase/name/category, the real string error, environment from the result source with stage=Correctness and profile=null, the real attempted cases and metrics; stale successful benchmark rows cannot turn the round into passed; not_run stays not_observed with total retained and no fabricated failed case or experience

The failed correctness case/code/error and the exact recorded experience id/version/content reach the next-round provider prompt and the pre-send audit (roundFacts deep-equal, selection lists the execution-sourced record); applying the next candidate and archive replay keep the failed candidate identity and the frozen facts
A rejected failed observation (queue receipt disagrees with the projection) does not grow the real experience repository
